descriptions.zh: 我们正在尝试使用神经科技将我们的意识远程连接到噬天巨兽的神经系统。我们现在相信这是驯服这头巨兽的唯一方法。
descriptions.en: We are experimenting with neurotechnology in an attempt to remotely connect our minds with the Behemoths' nervous system. We now believe this is the only way to tame the beast.

descriptions.zh:
天巨兽的意识远比我们预想的要庞大和复杂；我们现在明白，单一个体的思想不足以整合。我们的思想虽然比大多数人优越，但并非生来就适应那样的身体。

第一步是将我们人口的个体思想与这头噬天巨兽连接起来。先形成一条脆弱的纽带，然后很快变为一股洪流——一股安抚巨兽暴怒的洪流。
descriptions.en:
The Behemoth's consciousness is far more vast and complex than we anticipated; we now understand that a single individual's mind is insufficient for integration. Our minds, while superior to most, were never designed to be housed in such a body.

The first step will be to connect the individual minds of our population to the behemoth. A tenuous link at first that will soon become a torrent - a flood to soothe the Behemoth's raging fury.

descriptions.zh:
蜂巢内不容有任何偏差。而此时，专注对我们来说前所未有地重要。单个工蜂作为我们与噬天巨兽之间的桥梁是远远不够的，我们必须以完整的集体意识占据这头巨兽的心智。

这将改变我们。我们的意识将融为一体，我们将成为单一实体。这个几乎难以想象的概念令人难以接受，但我们无需担忧，因为我们很快就会成为星系中最强大的存在！
descriptions.en:
There can be no room for deviation within the hive. Never before has the need for focus been so crucial. A single drone won't suffice as a conduit between us and the Behemoth, we must inhabit the mind of the beast with our full, collective consciousness.

This will change us. Our minds will merge into one and we will become a single entity. This almost unfathomable notion is difficult to grapple with, but we need not worry as we will soon be the most powerful being in the galaxy!

descriptions.zh:
栖居于生物容器中的想法永远无法让我们安心。我们种族历经世代都以固态形态为主。那些先行者甚至无法想象我们即将面临的道路。然而，我们仍将抛弃机械化的框体，在血肉巨兽体内寻求庇护。

寄居血肉的我们，还能以机械之名称呼自己吗？这些问题的答案是一个响亮的<<错误：未找到>>。

推理链路判明，唯一的办法就是接受不确定性，正如生物体经常采取的行动那样。我们将在噬天巨兽的体内找到答案，作为一个整体。我们将与这生物融为一体，成为单一实体。自我们首次启动以来，生存就是我们的程序使命——现在则是繁荣昌盛。
descriptions.en:
The thought of inhabiting a biological vessel has always been unsettling. Our kind was forged through generations of solid-bodied drones. Those that came before could not conceive of the path we now tread. Yet, we will abandon our mechanized frames and take refuge within a living beast.

Fused within flesh, will we still be machine? The answer is a resounding <<ERROR: NOT FOUND>>.

Logic dictates that the only way forward is to embrace uncertainty, as biologicals so often do. Within the body of a Behemoth, we will find our answers. We will merge with the creature, becoming one. To survive has always been our prime directive - now we will thrive.

descriptions.zh: [GetInvadersLower]舰队的残留物带来了一个罕有的研究击毁。我们可以从中学到许多有助于生存的知识。
descriptions.en: The remains of the [GetInvadersLower] fleet provide a rare opportunity for study. We may learn much to ensure our survival.

descriptions.zh: [GetInvadersLower]的母星系；它们是谁？它们到底打我们什么主意？
descriptions.en: The home world of the [GetInvadersLower]; who were these people, and what did they want with us?

descriptions.zh: 从理论上讲，我们最近在噬天巨兽遗传学方面的突破可以扩展到进一步变异我们的创造物上。尽管遗传的稳定性仍是一个问题，但只要有时间和资源，我们有信心能创造出进一步的生物强化。
descriptions.en: Our recent breakthroughs in behemoth genetics could theoretically be expanded to further mutate our creations. Genetic stability is a concern, but with time and resources we are confident that we can bring about further biological enhancements.

descriptions.zh: 我们与巨兽之交已有时日。彻底的转变已唾手可得，只待我们的一声令下。我们所即之处将是飞升之巅，所弃之物莫过于星域凡尘。肉体、重力，于我将再无挂碍。
descriptions.en: We have communed with the Beast long enough. The transference is ready, awaiting only our command. We stand on the cusp of ascension, poised to abandon the pitiful ashes of our planetbound dominion and rise beyond the chains of flesh and gravity.

descriptions.zh: 噬天巨兽离开我们的星系后，便飘入虚空，最终消失得无影无踪。我们可以尝试解开这个谜团，但距离如此遥远，只能采用非常规方法。答案或许如同虚空本身一样模糊不清。
descriptions.en: After leaving our galaxy, the Behemoth drifted into the void, then vanished. We can try to unravel the mystery, but at this distance, only unconventional methods remain. The answers are likely as hazy as the void itself.
